tool_args.rationale: The eight rows identify the four parameters of the documented history-conditioned two-state ODE. The implementation reconstructs the initial memory state from each irregular, shifted raw prefix using the candidate fast timescale, then numerically integrates the coupled dynamics with RK4 and fits all four parameters by least squares. Fresh confirmation can assess whether this mechanistic fit meets the requested tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The eight available trajectories exceed the stated minimum for fitting the four-parameter coupled ODE; another probe is not needed before a fresh confirmation.
The endpoint-matched history-gap and coupled transient-lag signatures, along with horizon-dependent targets, contradict a history-independent snapshot relaxation.

considered_alternatives.option: Coarse adiabatic slow ODE or static linear law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These reduced laws omit the fast memory state implicated by the transient lag and the irregular history-dependent initialization.
It is explicitly irrelevant to identifying the target mechanism and incurs avoidable cost.
